---
title: "Style gallery"
description: "Sample PDFs of every docdesigner style."
---

Each style below sets the same short document. The left page shows the title
at the top of page 1. The right page shows a separate title page. The two
thesis styles show their title page and first chapter, and the review style
its first page and a body page. Click a page to open the PDF.

The specimen is a short note on divorce and net worth, using the public 2022
Survey of Consumer Finances. Its data and statistical tests are real, but its
analysis and prose were generated by an AI model and have not been vetted. It
is there to show the styles, not as a finding.

```{r gallery, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Built from the INSTALLED styles at site-build time, so a style that ships is
# never missing here and a retired one never lingers. The PDFs and thumbnails
# are committed under pkgdown/assets/specimens/ (dev/render-specimens.R, then
# dev/publish-specimens.R); a style without them is listed without pictures.
assets <- "../../pkgdown/assets/specimens"
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
first_sentence <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x))
  cut <- regexpr("\\. ", x)
  if (cut > 0) substr(x, 1, cut) else x
}
styles <- docdesigner::designer_styles()
styles <- styles[order(styles$set, styles$style), ]

thumb <- function(id, layout, label, suffix = "") {
  png <- sprintf("%s-%s%s.png", id, layout, suffix)
  if (!file.exists(file.path(assets, png))) return("")
  sprintf(paste0('<a class="dd-thumb" href="../specimens/%s-%s.pdf" title="Open the %s PDF">',
                 '<img src="../specimens/%s" alt="%s, %s: page 1" loading="lazy">',
                 '<span>%s</span></a>'),
          id, layout, label, png, id, label, label)
}

cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(styles)), function(i) {
  id <- styles$style[i]
  s <- docdesigner::designer_style(id)
  cols <- if ((s$page$columns %||% 1) == 2) 2L else 1L
  thesis <- identical(docdesigner:::dd_title_layout(s), "thesis")
  # A markup style (review) is shown as page 1 and a body page.
  markup <- docdesigner:::dd_markup_on(docdesigner:::dd_flatten_dotted(s))
  yaml <- if (markup) {
    sprintf("output:\n  docdesigner::pdf:\n    style: %s\n    changes_since: v1.0   # optional: a tag, commit or file", id)
  } else if (thesis) {
    sprintf("toc: true\noutput:\n  docdesigner::pdf:\n    style: %s", id)
  } else {
    sprintf("output:\n  docdesigner::pdf:\n    style: %s\n    title_layout: header   # or page", id)
  }
  paste0(
    '<div class="dd-card" data-set="', styles$set[i], '" data-cols="', cols, '">',
    '<h3>', esc(styles$label[i]), ' <code>', id, '</code></h3>',
    '<p class="dd-meta">', styles$set[i], ' set &middot; ',
    if (cols == 2L) "two columns" else "one column", ' &middot; ',
    esc(s$typography$body), '</p>',
    '<div class="dd-thumbs">',
    if (thesis) paste0(thumb(id, "thesis", "Title page"), thumb(id, "thesis", "First chapter", "-body"))
    else if (markup) paste0(thumb(id, "header", "Page 1: the map"), thumb(id, "header", "A body page", "-body"))
    else paste0(thumb(id, "header", "Title on page 1"), thumb(id, "page", "Title page")),
    '</div>',
    '<p class="dd-desc">', esc(first_sentence(styles$description[i])), '</p>',
    '<div class="dd-yaml"><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary dd-copy">Copy YAML</button>',
    '<pre><code>', esc(yaml), '</code></pre></div>',
    '</div>')
}, character(1))


cat("```{=html}\n")
cat('<div class="dd-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter styles">',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary" data-filter="all">All</button>',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-filter="set:academic">Academic</button>',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-filter="set:public">Public</button>',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-filter="cols:1">One column</button>',
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-filter="cols:2">Two columns</button>',
    '</div>\n', sep = "")
cat('<div class="dd-gallery">', paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), '</div>\n', sep = "\n")
cat("```\n")
```

```{=html}
<style>
.dd-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; margin: 1.2rem 0; }
.dd-gallery { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 1.4rem; }
.dd-card { border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: .4rem; padding: .9rem; }
.dd-card[hidden] { display: none; }
.dd-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.dd-desc { margin-top: .6rem; }
.dd-card h3 code { font-size: .85rem; }
.dd-card p { font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.dd-meta { color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #6c757d); }
.dd-thumbs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .5rem; }
.dd-thumb { display: block; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; font-size: .75rem; }
.dd-thumb img { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12); background: #fff; }
.dd-thumb:hover img { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.dd-yaml { position: relative; }
.dd-yaml pre { font-size: .78rem; margin: 0; padding: .6rem; }
.dd-copy { position: absolute; top: .3rem; right: .3rem; padding: .05rem .4rem; font-size: .7rem; }
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".dd-filters button");
  buttons.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var f = b.dataset.filter.split(":");
      document.querySelectorAll(".dd-card").forEach(function (c) {
        c.hidden = f[0] !== "all" && c.dataset[f[0]] !== f[1];
      });
      buttons.forEach(function (x) {
        x.classList.toggle("btn-secondary", x === b);
        x.classList.toggle("btn-outline-secondary", x !== b);
      });
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".dd-copy").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var code = b.parentElement.querySelector("code");
      var done = function () {
        b.textContent = "Copied";
        setTimeout(function () { b.textContent = "Copy YAML"; }, 1500);
      };
      // The Clipboard API needs a secure page; otherwise select the text and
      // use the older copy command.
      var fallback = function () {
        var r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
        var sel = window.getSelection(); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);
        if (document.execCommand("copy")) done();
      };
      if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.innerText).then(done, fallback);
      } else {
        fallback();
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

The specimens are made by `dev/render-specimens.R` in the
[repository](https://github.com/jncohen/docdesigner).
